mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 13, low 5.

US President Donald Trump said that U.S. allies in the Middle East must cover all costs incurred during the eight-month war with Iran, claiming the United States has already won the conflict, while Senator Marco Rubio warned that negotiations have made no progress.

Manchester United are reportedly close to dismissing manager Michael Carrick after a run of poor results that has left the club near the relegation zone in the Premier League.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has hired crisis-management experts to address a suspected espionage scandal that is threatening the company's reputation.

British boxer Zak Miller suffered a serious head injury during his bout with Gully Powar in Manchester but has reported that his health condition is stable.

Kosovar reality-show contestant Jona Krasniqi faced public backlash after old messages allegedly written by influencer Doresa were released by her family during the Big Brother VIP Kosovo 5 prime-time show.
